description: Fetch new Mattermost posts and record them in CallPilotAI's inbound messages, so a conversation there can be worked like mail or WhatsApp. Use this where the outgoing webhook cannot be set up — creating one needs more than plain user rights on the Mattermost side, reading a channel does not. Runs entirely server-side; nothing has to be running on anyone's desk. Optional: channel_id (default: every channel the account is in), limit per channel, since_hours to reach back on a first run. Repeats are harmless — a post already recorded is not recorded twice. Assigning a message to a lead is a separate step (find_lead_by_channel / link_channel); nothing is discarded for lack of one. A post that consists ONLY of a file is recorded too; its attachments are noted in the message metadata and can then be fetched with download_mattermost_file.

channel_id.description: Only this channel. Default: all the account can see.

since_hours.description: Reach this many hours back instead of continuing where the last run stopped.

name: sync_mattermost_messages
